newsitem.title: JAPAN: SHARES OF JAPAN'S CHIP EQUIPMENT MAKERS ADVANCE.
newsitem.headline: SHARES OF JAPAN'S CHIP EQUIPMENT MAKERS ADVANCE.

text.p: Shares of Japanese semiconductor equipment manufacturers jumped on Thursday morning, encouraged by a surge in U.S. chip equipment maker Applied Materials Inc's shares overnight, traders said.
By 0148 GMT, Tokyo Electron Ltd had gained 330 yen to trade at 7,650 yen, while Advantest Corp was up 700 yen at 12,500.
Nikon Corp was up 120 yen at 2,440, and Canon Inc was up 120 yen at 3,670.

"Applied Materials' rise in the United States prompted foreign investors to buy shares of similar manufacturers in Japan," said Harushige Kobayashi, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
On Wednedsay, the share price of Applied Materials surged $9.125 to $99.375 after the company reported earnings far exceeding Wall Street's expectations.
The shares' performance lifted other equipment makers' shares in the United States.
